nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 多伦多下起了细雪。你刚走进 PATH 地下步道，就看见一位拖着行李箱的女孩在三张方向牌之间来回确认。

nodes.speaker: Maya
nodes.text: Sorry — I'm trying to get to Union Station, but every sign seems to point somewhere different.

options.text: 「Which entrance are you trying to reach?」

nodes.speaker: Maya
nodes.text: The train hall, not the subway. Good question — I didn't realise there were two different entrances.

nodes.speaker: Maya
nodes.text: Maybe, but I need the train hall rather than the subway. We should check before we walk any farther.

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 你们找到一位正在换灯箱的工作人员。地下步道很吵，长句很容易被人声吞掉。

options.text: 「Are we heading the right way for the Union Station train hall?」

nodes.speaker: 工作人员
nodes.text: Yes. Keep straight, take the second escalator up, then turn left at the bakery.

nodes.speaker: 工作人员
nodes.text: Train hall or subway? Ah, the train hall — straight ahead, second escalator, then left at the bakery.

nodes.speaker: Maya
nodes.text: Straight, second escalator, left at the bakery. Let me repeat it so we don't lose a step.

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 几分钟后，车站大厅的天花板出现在扶梯上方。Maya 赶上了火车，也把一枚红色枫叶行李牌送给你。

nodes.speaker: Maya
nodes.text: You didn't need perfect directions. You asked one precise question, checked the answer, and got us here.

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 【获得 120 金币】回到街面时雪已经停了。你发现问路的关键不是记住整张地图，而是把下一步说清楚。
